protocol.calibration: fixed 336-policy grid; independent calibration roles only; no test selection
protocol.controlled_clock: common measured ASR+acoustic workers for all modalities; zero head latency for selection and common-clock test
protocol.measured_head: selected policies are also tested with actual per-call frozen head duration; no recalibration to these test results

limitations: Same previously inspected corpus and overlapping conversation splits; exploratory only.
Old and new heads both recalibrate on the same calibration roles; comparisons to prior inherited-policy numbers are not causal.
All modalities share acoustic service timing; this is an information/exposure control, not optimized text-only deployment.
Policy availability and matched pairs must be reported; means of different eligible runs are not a matched comparison.
Actual head durations are measured in cached-service replay, not live stateful ASR.
External Smart Turn audio could not be downloaded during persistent TLS timeouts; no external scores are reported.
